verdict.rationale: LM Studio is mainly a local LLM runner, but the Bionic page mentions running 'the latest frontier open models', which hints at a possible hosted tier. That makes this a fair question for the product. The evidence pack documents no pricing tiers, rate limits, or usage caps for any hosted cloud inference, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
